cpi.d: an index of the cost of all goods and services to a typical consumer

cps.d: the unit of frequency; one hertz has a periodic interval of one second

cpu.d: (computer science) the part of a computer (a microprocessor chip) that does most of the data processing

cpr.d: an emergency procedure consisting of external cardiac massage and artificial respiration; the first treatment for a person who has collapsed and has no pulse and has stopped breathing; attem

cpa.d: an accountant who has passed certain examinations and met all other statutory and licensing requirements of a United States state to be certified by that state
